verified_passage_locator: Stroke and high blood pressure; What happens when you have a stroke
verified_claim: The American Stroke Association explains that high blood pressure damages arteries and increases susceptibility to blockage or rupture. Weakened or blocked cerebral arteries increase stroke risk. Vessel blockage can cause ischemic stroke, while rupture can cause hemorrhagic stroke.
limitation_note: Arterial injury increases stroke risk but does not inevitably result in stroke. Ischemic and hemorrhagic stroke involve different vascular mechanisms. The source does not quantify individual risk or demonstrate that every arterial lesion causes stroke.
review_note: Verified American Stroke Association How High Blood Pressure Can Lead to Stroke, specifically Stroke and high blood pressure and What happens when you have a stroke.
